summary: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70; Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed, registered in Estonia. The Government of Estonia is reported as a controlling owner and shareholder, per Wikidata and OpenSanctions respectively, making this a possible state-owned enterprise; these are indicative findings from non-register sources and are not authoritative determinations. The Estonian e-Business Register records four current board members — Andrus Durejko, Marlen Tamm, Lauri Karp, and Gerrit Mäesalu (all from 2023–2026) — alongside several individuals holding influence by other means, including Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02), who is a possible name match for a politically exposed person across OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph; no birth date or nationality was available to confirm identity, so this remains unconfirmed. claims.text: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70; Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Estonia.

The Government of Estonia is indicatively reported as a controlling owner of Eesti Energia per Wikidata, and as a shareholder per OpenSanctions, making this a possible state-owned enterprise; these are non-register, indicative findings.

The Estonian e-Business Register records four current board members: Andrus Durejko (from 2023-04-03), Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-03), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-10), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-06-22).

The Estonian e-Business Register also records several individuals holding influence by other means, including Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-07-06), Anna Broughel (from 2025-06-02), Priit Rohumaa (from 2025-06-02), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-11), Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02), Kristi Klaas (from 2024-06-10), Andrus Durejko (from 2023-04-18), Kaur Kajak (from 2023-04-18), Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-18), and Anne Mere (from 2022-07-19).

Jürgen Ligi, recorded as holding influence by other means from 2024-08-02, is a possible name match for a politically exposed person across OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph; no birth date or nationality was available to confirm identity, so this remains unconfirmed.
GLEIF Level 2 data shows no accounting-consolidation parent reported for EESTI ENERGIA AS, as both the direct and ultimate parent positions carry a permitted NON_CONSOLIDATING reporting exception.
The ownership chain has three or more corporate layers, which is a structural indicator warranting further review (medium confidence, per GLEIF).
EESTI ENERGIA AS is recorded as the direct accounting-consolidation parent of Enefit OÜ, Enefit Oy, and ENEFIT INDUSTRY AS per GLEIF.
EESTI ENERGIA AS also holds shareholdings in Enefit Green and Attarat Power Co., per OpenSanctions.
A material licensing limitation applies: OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be commercially re-used without separate authorisation.

risks.label: No parent in GLEIF (permitted reporting exception)
risks.rationale: No accounting-consolidation parent is reported to GLEIF: NON_CONSOLIDATING for the direct and ultimate parent (its controlling legal entities are not subject to preparing consolidated financial statements). Structural context, not a risk finding — these are permitted exceptions under the LEI ROC policy, and GLEIF Level 2 records accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership.

risks.label: Complex ownership layers
risks.rationale: Ownership chain has 3 corporate layers (AMLA threshold: ≥3).

risks.label: State-controlled (possible SOE)
risks.rationale: A controlling owner is a state or state body — a possible state-owned enterprise. Corroborating indicator (Wikidata-sourced); not a determination, and its absence is not evidence the entity is privately owned.

risks.label: Outside EU/EEA
risks.rationale: Ownership chain reaches jurisdictions outside the EU/EEA: JO. Structural context, not a risk finding — neither the AMLA CDD RTS nor AMLR Annex III treats non-EU status as a risk factor in itself. Contributes to AMLA Article 12(1) condition (b) only where it appears on the layered ownership path.
